label: PF Backlog 173
title: Preflight guard: instructions+context <= 0.8*model window (soft compact, hard-fail only if instructions alone overflow)
body: OPTIONAL/low priority while the tier uses 1M-window models (max instruction 46.6KB = 4.8%). Purpose: on small-window tiers, before the LLM call check instruction_tokens + context_tokens <= 0.8*window; if over, SOFT-compact the ambient CONTEXT to fit (never touch static instructions) and warn; HARD-fail only if instructions alone exceed the window (unrecoverable). Avoids accidental chunking (N calls, instructions re-sent) / un-chunkable overflow. Also log instruction/context sizes per agent/run for visibility.
_note: core/context_preflight.py (check/log_verdict); wired core/orchestrator/agent_runner.py _build_agent_prompt (soft compact-warning + hard-fail if instructions alone >80% window). Verified verdicts: full/compact_context/hard_fail. compileall=0, wired_audit=0.
